description: This Java source file defines the UserService class, which manages user-related operations such as registration, authentication, password management, user retrieval, and account lockout handling within a book-tracking application. It interacts with repositories, handles exceptions, and enforces security and validation logic.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class providing user account operations such as registration, authentication, password management, and account locking mechanisms.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user, validates input, ensures email uniqueness, saves user, and authenticates.

methods.name: createNewUser
methods.description: Creates a new User entity with default role and encoded password.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the currently authenticated user from security context.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns list of all users (likely for testing or administrative purposes).

methods.name: findUserById
methods.description: Finds a user by their ID.

methods.name: findUserByEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by email address.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Performs authentication for the given user.

methods.name: isEmailInUse
methods.description: Checks whether an email is already registered.

methods.name: changeUserEmail
methods.description: Updates user's email after validation and password confirmation.

methods.name: isPasswordStrengthVeryStrong
methods.description: Evaluates if a password meets the required strength level.

methods.name: isPasswordTooWeak
methods.description: Checks if a password is weaker than very strong.

methods.name: changeUserPassword
methods.description: Updates user's password after strength validation.

methods.name: deleteUserById
methods.description: Removes a user account and associated data; handles related entities cleanup.

methods.name: passwordIsIncorrect
methods.description: Validates if a given password matches the current user's password.

methods.name: removePredefinedShelfFromUserBooks
methods.description: Removes predefined shelves associations from user’s books during deletion.

methods.name: increaseFailAttempts
methods.description: Increment failed login attempts count.

methods.name: resetFailAttempts
methods.description: Reset failed login attempts count.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks user account and sets lock time.

methods.name: hoursUntilUnlock
methods.description: Calculates hours remaining until account unlock.

methods.name: unlockWhenTimeExpired
methods.description: Automatically unlocks user if lock duration has expired.
